entries.content:
Houndoom is the last stage in the Houndour, Houndoom evolutionary line. Split evenly between male and female genders Houndoom are a doglike quadrupedal pokemon species that bear a heavy resemblance to mythical hell hounds. They possess black fur, a long orange snout, and an orange underbelly. It has small red eyes and a black nose. Around its neck is a white band with a small skull-shaped pendant on its throat. There are two white bands on each of its ankles, as well as three rib-like ridges on its back. Houndoom has a long, skinny tail with a triangular tip and three clawed toes on each paw. Atop its head is a pair of long, curved gray horns. These horns are smaller on the female than the male. Alpha Houndoom are known to be far larger and more dominant regardless of gender commonly overpowering and dominating their trainers in extreme cases. As canines they live in packs by nature, and are incredibly protective and possessive of those they view as belonging to their pack, the most common example being their trainers.
As a canine they possess a knotted penis that remains sheathed inside them when not in use, only extending when aroused, it is red with a knot several times larger than the shaft intended to lock their mate together upon orgasm.
